verses.text: You were dead because of your trespasses and sins, but God made you alive.
At one time you lived the way this world lives, following the ruler of the power of the air—the spirit now at work in those who disobey.
We all once lived among them, following the desires of our human nature and thoughts. Like everyone else, we were headed for God's anger.
But God is rich in mercy, and because he loved us so deeply,
he made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses. You have been saved by grace!
God raised us up with Christ and seated us with him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,
so that in the ages to come he could show the immeasurable riches of his grace through his kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
You have been saved by grace through faith. This isn't from yourselves; it's God's gift.
It doesn't come from works, so no one can brag.
We are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to live out.
So remember that you Gentiles by birth were called ‘the uncircumcised’ by those called ‘the circumcised’—a physical mark made by human hands.
At that time you were apart from Christ, excluded from Israel's citizenship, strangers to the covenants of promise, without hope and without God in the world.
But now in Christ Jesus, you who once were far away have been brought near through Christ's blood.
Christ himself is our peace. He made the two groups one and broke down the dividing wall of hostility,
by setting aside in his body the law with its commands and regulations. His purpose was to create one new humanity from the two groups, making peace,
and to reconcile both to God in one body through the cross, putting the hostility to death there.
He came and announced peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.
Through him, both groups have access to the Father by one Spirit.
So you are no longer foreigners or outsiders. You are fellow citizens with God's people and members of God's household.
You are built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the cornerstone.
In him, the whole building is joined together and grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
And in him, you too are being built together into a home where God lives by his Spirit.
